Scoped Filters Workspace

Start here: choose scope, then open the app you need

This page is the simple front door. It sets one scope for two separate engines: Manager ACT uses the main account datasets minus Prospecting, while the other Action Checker tabs continue to use the fact table.

Basic Filters

Pick Rep, Manager, and Action here. The detailed top panels stay hidden on this start page and are driven by these selections.

Date Range & Unified Search

Dates are shared by both apps. The search value filters Action Checker fact rows and Manager ACT account list fields.

Load Confirmation

Review the scope below, then load both engines. Manager ACT refreshes its account datasets minus Prospecting. Action Checker refreshes fact-table rows for the same date/filter context.

Manager ACTMain datasetsAccount Management, Cadence, Louise Brown, Logistics

Visual guide: how to use Action Leaderboard
1. Choose filtersActions ▼Reps ▼

Search and multi-select. Reps appear from loaded data.

2. Shared date windowStart dateEnd dateReset dates

One date range for action and all-date loads.

3. Load & manageLoad dates/actionsLoad dates/actionsVideo guide

Loading shows progress and row counts.

Recommended workflow: Pick actions/reps → set shared dates → load records → use Record Explorer to double-click a row for the professional record view.
Smart date behavior: widening the all-date range now queries missing date gaps and adds them to cache. Narrowing the range filters what is already loaded instead of re-downloading everything.
🎯

Actions

Use the searchable dropdown to select one or many actions. Bad pipe-delimited note fragments are removed from action values.

Reps

The rep dropdown is built from loaded fact rows, so it reflects the current dataset.

Records

In Record Explorer, double-click a row to open a clean record display with account, action, rep, status, dates, and notes.
